title: Open Weights, and the Keys That Go With Them
description: Five top stories and six briefs follow open weights for a trillion-parameter model, a rewritten model spec, a personal agent on a Pentagon network, and a voice-AI acquisition.

mistral-large-4-open-weights.verification_scope: Company figures for coding and cybersecurity benchmarks; a downloadable model can also be misused

openai-model-spec-values.verification_scope: Official Model Spec update; described as a direction current models do not yet fully meet

dod-agent-credentials.verification_scope: Anonymous sources cited by WIRED, not confirmed by the parties; commentary read separately

microsoft-voluntary-exit.verification_scope: News report and people familiar with the matter; Microsoft has not publicly confirmed the offer

deepgram-daily-pipecat.verification_scope: Acquisition report; executive remarks are paraphrased, not verified verbatim quotations

thrive-holdings-adt.verification_scope: Deal report; no specific AI product has been announced

gemini-file-editing.verification_scope: Product report; PDF on web and phone, other formats web-only for now

meta-style-sketch.verification_scope: Store listing in three countries; Meta did not comment and wider launch is unknown

wabi-funding.verification_scope: Funding report of the new personal-agent positioning

dream-aec-world-model.verification_scope: Founders' claims about training data and projects in use

spawn-agent-swarm.verification_scope: Developer's own account, as recommended by Simon Willison

granite-switch-411.verification_scope: Publisher's account; model not run; license follows the model page

silentcall-review.verification_scope: Preprint on two Qwen sizes, one payload, and one trigger; not peer reviewed and not a new paper from this window

ghodsi-open-tokens.verification_scope: Paraphrase of a published excerpt; not a response to today's Mistral release

tibo-layered-defense.verification_scope: Paraphrase of lab training practice; not a comment on today's contractor incident
